home.heroTitle:
A home for the days
we spend together.
home.intro: This is a keepsake for our family of three. Not a grand story—just the places we go, the things we say, and the ordinary days we want time to remember for us.
home.noteText: A windy bike ride by the river on Sunday. We all came home smiling like fools.
home.albumIntro: Our album grows slowly with time. It is not about perfect composition, only about keeping our moments where they belong.
home.journeyIntro: Our vlogs live on Bilibili. This site keeps the doorway to them, without needing a video server.
home.storiesTitle: Written down, ordinary days begin to echo.
home.storyIntro: Travel notes, small milestones, and the little things we only learn to treasure later.
home.quote:
A keepsake is simply
saying goodbye to today with care.

gallery.title: Album
gallery.intro: Photographs are grouped by trip and time. Every image comes from a local folder—replace the files and update the index.
gallery.empty: There are no photos in this album yet.
gallery.localHintText: Place photos in public/albums and register them in app/data/albums.ts.

journeys.title: Journeys
journeys.intro: Videos are played through Bilibili's embedded player. Each card is only an index entry, so you do not need to host the video yourself.
journeys.replaceHint: Replace the BV ids in app/data/journeys.ts to use your own videos.

stories.title: Stories
stories.intro: Articles are stored as Markdown, separate from the page layout. Redesigning the reading experience never requires touching the text.
stories.newArticleText: Create a Markdown file in content/stories and fill in its frontmatter. It will appear here automatically.
stories.notFound: This story could not be found.

about.title: About the three of us
about.intro: One father, one mother, and one little person growing up far too quickly. We love weekend adventures, and equally love doing nothing at home.
about.storyOne: Social media fragments our lives and the feed keeps moving. We wanted a quiet place where photos, videos, and words could stay together.
about.storyTwo: It does not need to be seen by many people. It only needs to remind us, years from now, what we ate, where the wind touched us, and the lovely things our child said.
about.memberOne: Drives, takes photos, and makes the itinerary too ambitious.
about.memberTwo: Finds beautiful light, good food, and the exact moment to stop and rest.
about.memberThree: Creates surprises, asks the most questions, and makes most of the laughter.
about.timelineOneText: Two people decided to share a life, and to keep a few more photographs.
about.timelineTwoText: A tiny new person joined the family, and every outing gained a little chair.
about.timelineThreeText: Keepsake is live. We hope it holds many more ordinary weekends that glow.
about.techOne: Albums, stories, and videos have separate data; content is not trapped in the layout.
about.techTwo: Photos live in the local public directory without an image-hosting service.
about.techThree: Bilibili videos are embedded only, so the site stores no video files.
